protocol.name: wayluck_picker_unstable_v1
protocol.description:
How `wayluck pick` (xdg-desktop-portal-wlr's chooser_cmd) learns what the user can share, to show it in its picker. The user's choice stays with the picker: it prints it for the portal. Nothing is shared by asking.
Unstable: changed in place, without version bumps, until it's frozen.

request.name: pick
request.description: The answer comes as events on the new object: what can be shared, then done.

request.name: thumbnail
request.description: Like ext_image_copy_capture_manager_v1.create_session (without cursors), but the session's frames are no bigger than width × height: the source drawn scaled down to fit, keeping its shape (or as it is, if it fits already). Its buffer_size events say the size. For a picker's thumbnails, which would otherwise each hold a frame as big as its source.

request.name: workspace_source
request.description: A capture source for a workspace (by its id from a workspace event): its windows, as they're laid out in it, whether it's shown or not.

event.name: monitor
event.description: In the order the monitors are in. Shared as "Monitor: NAME".

event.name: window
event.description: One of the windows of the workspace named last (in a workspace event before it, since the last monitor event), or with none, of what the monitor named last shows; the topmost first. id is its ext-foreign-toplevel-list identifier (as a number): it's shared as "Window: ID".

event.name: workspace

description.summary: a workspace, on the monitor named last

event.description: As its window manager offered it, by name: the windows after it are its own. id is to capture it (workspace_source).
